prerequisites: EM1012 - Mecánica de Máquinas y Estructuras
EM1015 - Ciencia y Tecnología de Materiales
EM1019 - Elasticidad y Resistencia de Materiales
EM1020 - Teoría de Máquinas y Mecanismos
EM1028 - Máquinas e Instalaciones de Fluidos

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to organize teamwork for the design of a complete machine within an established deadline.
Know how to use CAD and CAE (multibody systems and finite elements) computer resources for the preliminary and detailed design of machine elements.
Correctly use basic technical terminology for machine design, in English.
Be able to prepare and orally defend reports or machine projects.
Be able to select from diverse and dispersed documentation for autonomous learning in topics related to machine design.
Be able to analyze and design machines at a conceptual, preliminary, and detailed level.
Be able to identify the hazards of a machine and propose designs or safeguards to eliminate or reduce them.
Be able to explain the physicomathematical foundations of the finite element method applied to solid mechanics problems.
Be able to structure the integral project of a real machine into stages.
Be able to select the actuators and control elements of the machine.
Be able to perform the preliminary design of mechanisms and transmission systems of machines.
Be able to perform detailed designs of structural, guiding, and transmission systems of machines.
Be able to propose, evaluate, and prioritize different alternatives for the conceptual design of machines, using appropriate design methodologies.

syllabus_topics: Preliminary design of transmissions with Google Sheets (2 sessions)
Multibody system analysis with SolidWorks (2 sessions)
teaching_methods: Lectures (oral exposition by the professor with blackboard and multimedia presentations)
Laboratory work (use of CAE tools, identification and analysis of mechanical elements, mechanisms and safety devices)
Project-based learning (complete machine design project in groups, with intermediate presentations and autonomous learning)
Autonomous study for the final exam
assessment_rules: To pass the course, students must obtain at least 5 points out of 10 in the overall average grade. The final exam requires a minimum mark of 3.5 out of 10. If the minimum mark in any part is not achieved, the overall average grade cannot exceed 4.5 out of 10. For the first and second sittings, students are considered presented if they take the final exam. Laboratory attendance and reports are not recoverable; the machine project is recoverable in the second sitting. For the extraordinary sitting for final studies, the final exam accounts for 100% of the grade.
